hypothesis: Schema-constrained planning removes prose/format failures while explicit complete-task instruction avoids replacing manipulation with a visibility-only navigation plan. Syntax is not a semantic completeness certificate.
comparison: H10 original-start failed at initial planning: zero controls, one model call; retained in full-start failure denominator. No SR comparison with warm-start diagnostics.

static_result.manual_outcome_coverage: Both task instructions covered; no claim of stable object identity, executable grasp poses or task success
risks: Radio level=true is conservative and restricts held-arm rotations
Plate left/right and bowl first/second target descriptions may be unstable; no plate policy episode in this block

static_independent_semantic_review.plates_limit: Operation/count coverage only; pizza-vs-plate contact target and SAME-fridge/ONE-sink identity bindings remain unresolved. Not a plate deployment pass.

static_gate.acceptance: All saved initial image hashes and task identities match; strict parsing and manual whole-task coverage, hand compatibility and non-hallucinated current-state review. No repeated prompt search or saved-plan injection.

engineering_gates.start_after: Both static plans pass human coverage check; immutable source review passes; original hardware/sensor/physical thresholds unchanged

fullstart.start_after: Both exact-source engineering gates pass and processes exit

stop_conditions: CPU grammar or static manual plan failure
Original hard physical/sensor gate or budget stop
No silent format repair or model retry
Disk free below 80GiB or cumulative H10/H11 root above 4GiB
limitations: Schema does not establish task coverage or correct visual grounding
Manual two-task plan audit is not a 50-task semantic validator
Development train instances are not unseen evaluation
Every attempted original-start failure remains counted
